title: Eliminate double structured-clone of resolved spec objects across worker boundaries
motivation: The resolved spec object (a fully-dereferenced JSON tree, 5–15MB) currently crosses TWO structured-clone boundaries on every diff run: (1) dereference-worker → main thread, (2) main thread → diff-worker. Each clone can freeze the main thread 200–600ms per side. The deref worker already produces a stringified JSON string; the fix is to pass that string to the diff worker which parses it internally (off-thread).

tasks.title: Remove `resolved` from dereference-worker's `done` message
tasks.description: In src/workers/dereference-worker.js: change postMessage done payload to only send `stringified` (JSON string) and `refCount`. Drop `resolved` from the message so structured clone never copies the object to the main thread.

tasks.title: Pass stringified JSON strings to diff-worker instead of resolved objects
tasks.description: In src/hooks/use-diff-worker.js: after the parallel deref await, forward `{ id, oldJson: oldStringified, newJson: newStringified }` to the diff worker instead of `{ id, oldResolved, newResolved }`. Remove the structured clone of both resolved objects.

tasks.title: Parse JSON strings inside diff-worker before flattening
tasks.description: In src/workers/diff-worker.js: accept `{ oldJson, newJson }` strings, call JSON.parse on each (off-thread), then pass the parsed objects to flatten(). Add a progress stage 'parsing-old'/'parsing-new' before 'flattening-old'/'flattening-new'.

tasks.title: Update runDiff return type — drop resolved, keep stringified
tasks.description: In src/hooks/use-diff-worker.js: the runDiff() return no longer has oldResolved/newResolved (they were never serialized to the main thread). Callers that need the object can JSON.parse(oldStringified) lazily. Update the return shape.

tasks.title: Fix countRefs: count on original text string, not serialized object
tasks.description: In src/workers/dereference-worker.js: replace countRefs(parsed) with a regex on the original `text` input. This eliminates a hidden O(n) JSON.stringify just to count $ref occurrences.

tasks.title: Remove structuredClone(parsed) before $RefParser.dereference
tasks.description: In src/workers/dereference-worker.js: $RefParser.dereference does not mutate its input. The structuredClone guard is unnecessary and costs 50–200ms on large specs. Remove it.
